# Emailing using Google Sheet, Google Docs and SMTP
This is a simple system to automate emailing.

## How it works

- The Google Docs template is your email to be sent and contains the message and variables (firstname, lastname, company, email).
- The Google Sheet is your list of contacts.
- For each contact, we create the final email, we send it using SMTP protocol (with a Batch Size of 1) and we manage the SMTP quota.
- The **process** column of the Google Sheet is updated with date/time after email is sent.


## How to use
1. Download the [Google Docs Template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sR1Mjee0heur6CgEV_ssYzOUbFNaDnyEnPSt1CFEMWI/edit?usp=sharing) and [Google Sheet Template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mFKp3wmbV9qp2tpGGsN72zdiC32y8H1nhjdgP885y-U/edit?usp=sharing). Identify the ID of both documents in your own environment.
   - The ID is the `string` between d/ and /edit ... spreadsheets/d/`1mFKp3wmba1b2c3N72zdiC32y8H1nhjdgP85y-U`/edit?gid=1234

2. Define the Subject of your emailing campaing and setup the Google Sheet & Docs ID in the `settings` node

3. Configure your Google credentials and SMTP parameters

4. Update both Google Docs & Sheet with your own message and list of contacts
   - The Google Docs template can contain the following variables `{{firstname}}` `{{lastname}}` `{{company}}` `{{email}}`
   - The header of the Google Sheet should contain the following columns **email**, **firstname**, **lastname**, **company**, **process**, **err**

## Requirements
- **Google credentials** to access your documents
- **SMTP** server, up and running. Update the `Wait` node with what works for you
- **n8n version** this workflow was tested on 1.105.2 (Ubuntu)

## Need Help?

Contact me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephaneheckel/) or ask in the [Forum](https://community.n8n.io/)!
